title: Provider Response
description: Raw response wrapper from a single provider. Contains either content (success) or error (failure).

provider.description: The provider configured for this member (e.g. openai, openrouter), preserved from the request. Not necessarily the effective route: under Otari routing the call is dispatched through Otari while this field keeps the configured provider.

display_name.description: Member identity used as the key in council output. Equals the configured display_name, or the provider name when none is set.

success.description: Whether the provider returned a valid response.

content.description: Raw response content from the provider. Present when success is true.

error.description: Error message. Present when success is false.
